items.title: The direct image along a set-valued functor is right adjoint to the stalk functor
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for any set-valued functor the direct image on presheaves is right adjoint to the stalk functor (statement lines 8174-8179). The proof is a short but complete argument: a morphism from a presheaf into the direct image of a set is a compatible system of maps from the values times the values of the functor into the set, and the description of the stalk shows that a morphism out of the stalk into the set is the same kind of compatible system (proof lines 8182-8192), which gives the asserted bijection. The non-formal content is the comparison of the two descriptions. The claim is H1: a one-step comparison with its inputs named.
